page.layout: One printed page (p. 160), one block of running text in a single column, with no marginal notes. A catchword stands at the lower right. The thin strip at the far right edge is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: us , ( in quamplurimis saltem ) Evangelio prædi-cato non præsuppono, sed ab illo effici, cum per-multi improbi ad verbi auditi sonum converti le-gantur, Gratia Christi, quæ Prædicationem istam comitata est, corda ipsorum emolliente, ut fertur de Zacchæo, deque tribus Judæorum millibus, qui ad Petri concionem corde compuncti sunt, ob Christi Crucifixionem à se procuratam, Aliisque pluribus in Historia Evangelica memoratis. Scrip-tura item multoties hanc verbi prædicati virtutem magnifice extollit. Paulus enim diserte asserit, Evan-gelium Christi à se prædicatum, esse Potentiam Dei ad salutem omni credenti. Rom. 1. 16. Potentiam item sive virtutem Dei, iis qui salvi sunt. 1. Cor. 1. 18. affimilatur malleo Petræ conterenti. Jer. 23. 29. gladio ancipiti, & penetranti. Hebr. 4. 12. Sa-gittæ electæ, seu politæ. Isa. 49. 2. Nivi & Pluviæ, quæ Terram fecundant. Isa. 55. 10, 11. & seminii fructifero. Luc. 18. 11. Illi quoque attribuitur spi-ritualis Nativitas, Jac. 1. 18. 1 Pet. 1. 23. vita spiritualis. Jo. 6. 63.Illuminatio spiritualis. Psal. 119. 105. 2 Pet. 1. 19. sanctificatio spiritualis Jo. 17. v. 17. & vita æterna. Jo. 6. 68. & 20. 31. Octavo, Culpam Peccati in Justificatis manere, quando Reatus tollitur; quia sc. in Justificatione Peccata teguntur, & non imputantur. Smalcius, Err. 157. Nono, Quod in Christo confidendum sit (cum sit nudus Homo) non ut in objecto primario nostræ salutis, sed tan-tum ut in objecto intermedio, seu causa instrumen-tali. Ita Socinus contra Wiekum. cap. 4. Hæc sunt ipsius verba — Atqui, nec in Christo Homine ita con-fidendum est nobis, ut in nostra Felicitatis Auctore, id est, sola & prima causa — Nec unquam probabunt Adversarii, alia Ratione, aliamve ob causam, in

page.notes: Catchword "Christi" stands alone at the lower right and is recorded only in bottom_margin. Right-hand strip is the adjoining page edge and is omitted. Italic runs are marked from the scan; the boundaries of the italic passage around "Adversarii" are slightly uncertain. Spellings are copied as printed, including "Wiekum", "63.Illuminatio" (missing space after the printed full stop) and "Err. 157.". Long s was normalised to s. The running head "fana" was read as "sana". Words with the printed hyphen at line ends were kept hyphenated, e.g. praedi-cato, Scrip-tura, Evan-gelium, instrumen-tali.
